verdict.rationale: n8n is a workflow automation platform built around triggered executions. The pack documents webhook triggers, error workflows for handling failures, and multi-step agents. Hands-on reports describe scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks running in production, millions of workflows a year on a small server, and unattended subreddit monitoring that ends in notifications. Execution history lets users audit those unattended runs, though one user reports sporadic errors they handle with retries. Missing for 10: first-party docs for a schedule/cron trigger, and documentation of background execution or queue mode for long-running autonomous runs.
